description: Saves the brand voice notes (how this business writes: tone, words to use or avoid). Replaces the previous voice text entirely, so read brand_get first and include anything worth keeping. Uses no quota and sends nothing. Reversible by saving the old text again. Only save what the person dictated or approved. Requires API key scope: draft.

voice.description: The full voice notes to save, in plain sentences. Replaces the current text.

name: brand_set_voice
title: Save brand voice
